description: Test suite for allowlist matching functions in 'allowlist-match.js'. It verifies in-place array modifications affect the allowlist matching logic and allows dynamic updates to allowlist entries. The tests focus on functions 'resolveAllowlistMatchSimple' and 'resolveAllowlistMatchByCandidates'.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistMatchSimple
methods.description: Function that determines if a senderId is allowed based on an allowFrom list, considering in-place modifications.

methods.name: resolveAllowlistMatchByCandidates
methods.description: Function that determines if any candidate matches allowList entries, dynamically re-evaluated after in-place updates.
